# Install Edva

**Audience:** new users<br>
**Status:** current setup guide<br>
**Audited:** `8b8cb19`<br>
**Evidence:** `build.sh`, `selfhost/src/edva.dva`

Edva currently targets Linux hosts. Install `libLLVM-18` system-wide and make
sure `clang` and Nushell (`nu`) are on `PATH`. LLVM 18 is a link-time
requirement of the compiler; another installed LLVM version does not replace it.

From a checkout of this repository, build the compiler:

```sh
./build.sh
```

The build regenerates the token and operator tables, builds `edva`, and runs
the regression suite. To check a successful build manually:

```sh
./edva --help
```

If linking cannot find LLVM, confirm that the LLVM 18 development package is
installed. The build script consults `llvm-config` when it is available. If
the compiler can emit IR but cannot produce a binary, check that `clang` is on
`PATH`.

For a different target, pass a target triple and provide a compatible clang
and linker:

```sh
./edva program.dva -target aarch64-linux-gnu
```

See the [CLI reference](../reference/edva-cli.qmd) for the complete options.
